note: Imperial Group voice rules for copywriters and the copy check. Companion to BRAND-GUIDE.md (v6 deliverable 7). Matching is case-insensitive on whole words; a phrase matches as written. avoid: words that do not appear in public copy, each with its replacement. prefer: the house words. capitalise: terms that take a capital and when. cta_patterns: labels that name the next step. never_claim: claims no Imperial page makes, with the patterns the check scans for. No em dash in any form anywhere (npm run check).

never_claim.claim: A guaranteed or assured outcome of any application a government decides
never_claim.allowed: Denials only: 'We never guarantee', 'does not guarantee', and the FAQ answer 'No one honestly can.'

never_claim.claim: Influence with, connections to, or shortcuts through any government or official
never_claim.allowed: Denials only: 'We claim no influence with, or shortcuts through, any government.'

never_claim.claim: A fee, price, price range or discount on a page
never_claim.allowed: The optional budget bands on a form, and 'costs set out in writing, option by option, before you decide'

never_claim.claim: A processing time or a speed of outcome
never_claim.allowed: 'An honest timeline, updated as things move' and the form question 'When would you like to begin?'

never_claim.claim: A reply time or that a person has already read the enquiry
never_claim.allowed: 'One person will be your point of contact, and will reply to arrange a first conversation.'

never_claim.claim: Eligibility, fit or that an application has begun, from a form or a quiz
never_claim.allowed: 'Nothing here decides anything. Your answers simply prefill your enquiry.'

never_claim.claim: A service, licence, partnership, investment capability or financial service that does not yet exist or is unverified
never_claim.allowed: Only with a source record, otherwise a To confirm chip; Real Estate says 'licensed and has not yet launched' until the licence details are published

never_claim.claim: A client result, testimonial, statistic or number without a dated source
never_claim.allowed: The brochure figures with their 'As at' date once confirmed; events and leadership as documented

never_claim.claim: Regulated tax, legal or investment advice from Imperial itself
never_claim.allowed: 'Advice on regulated matters such as tax, legal or investment is provided only by appropriately qualified specialists.'

never_claim.claim: That a submission was delivered when it was simulated or the send failed
never_claim.allowed: 'Your enquiry is with <division>' only after the backend confirmed; otherwise the failure text with both offices and the email

never_claim.claim: That a file or guide was sent when none exists
never_claim.allowed: 'The guide is being finalised. Leave your name and email and we will let you know when it is ready.'

never_claim.claim: Status, exclusivity or wealth as the benefit
never_claim.allowed: Describe the life: 'Where the family can live, travel, study and settle.'
